scope: Preserve the active desktop tab and exact tabbed dock state through desktop-to-mobile-to-desktop viewport changes for groups docked on either side.
root_cause: The in-memory desktop breakpoint snapshot stored only left/right open state. In a tabbed group whose active tab differed from the physical group side, restoring the desktop state could select the other tab. The snapshot now also retains the active panel and reapplies it after both dock states are restored.
reused_project_patterns: Existing responsive desktop dock snapshot and panel lifecycle
Existing workspace tab ARIA state and canvas-safe CSS Grid
